title: Cookie Policy
description: Cookies and browser storage used by {{COMPANY_NAME}}.
body:
This page describes cookies and browser storage used by {{COMPANY_NAME}} at {{SITE_URL}}.

## 1. Essential authentication

The administrator area uses Netlify Identity access and refresh cookies to maintain authenticated sessions. Authentication storage is needed for administrator access; visitors do not need an administrator account to browse the public site or submit a project inquiry. Administrator integration connection flows may also use a temporary browser-binding cookie when those integrations are enabled.

## 2. Optional analytics and consent

No optional analytics or advertising trackers are enabled for launch. The site has support for optional analytics and marketing tags, but those tags load only if configured and after the visitor accepts optional tracking. When this feature is enabled, the consent choice is kept in browser local storage. Rejecting optional tracking prevents those tags from loading through this consent mechanism.

## 3. Other browser storage

Browser storage can retain interface preferences when the corresponding controls are used. Project inquiry form values are held in the current page session rather than saved as a persistent browser draft. Authentication cookies and browser local storage are different mechanisms; clearing either can reset the related session or preference.

## 4. External services

The current public pages link to external portfolio and social services rather than embedding them. Following a link takes you to a separate service whose storage practices are independent. Netlify, Neon and Resend support hosting, project records and correspondence; they are not advertising trackers added to the public page by this site.

## 5. Browser controls

You can inspect, delete or restrict cookies and site storage in your browser settings. Blocking authentication cookies can prevent administrator login. If optional tracking is enabled, its consent controls allow you to accept or reject it. See the Privacy Policy for information about project records and contact details.
